pageDescription: Government-approved AIS-140 compliant GPS tracking devices for commercial vehicles, transport operators, and fleet compliance requirements. Available in 2G/4G variants with mandatory features including panic button, real-time location transmission, tamper alerts, internal battery backup, and over-speed notifications. Certified for public transport, school buses, taxis, logistics fleets, and all vehicles requiring Ministry of Road Transport & Highways (MoRTH) regulatory compliance.
